creativity.description: How much AI-generated detail to add during upscaling, from 0 (faithful) to 100.

flavor.description: Processing style: `vivid` for enhanced color and detail, `natural` for faithful reproduction.

fpsBoost.description: Whether to increase the output frame rate.

resolution.description: Target output resolution from 720p to 4k. Defaults to `2k`.

smartGrain.description: Grain and texture enhancement from 0 to 100.
